text:
Taylor M.: quick heads-up — our kid's school announced an unexpected 10-day closure next month. I'm currently on a 4-week unpaid extension after parental leave. Had to book emergency in-home care for weekdays. 2 Qs: is there a hardship childcare credit or leave-bank transfer to cover extra costs? And does the childcare stipend resume while I'm on unpaid extension if I submit docs?

Sofia (People Ops): sorry that's stressful. Short: unpaid extension generally pauses the standard stipend. We do have a small hardship credit pool for unexpected closures; it's discretionary. Please submit the Emergency Family Support form with receipts + school closure notice. Link: https://intranet.redwood/benefits/emergency-support.

Ari (Payroll): If benefits approves a credit, we'll run it through payroll as a benefit payment and it'll be taxable. If you prefer a different treatment, note it on the form and Benefits will advise. Also note payroll cutoff: submit by 7 business days before month-end to hit next cycle.

Maya (Manager): Taylor I can cover your critical deliverables and swap a few meetings. Also happy to attest on the form — ping me when you submit and I'll approve. We can also use the team leave bank to donate up to 5 days if you want an unpaid->paid conversion for those days.

Office-Admin: If you need priority lactation room access when you come on campus, DM me dates and I'll block it.

School-Bureau: School closure official notice received? Attach PDF to the form to speed review. Code: SC-CLSR-10.

Taylor M.: Submitted the form just now, attached receipts and closure PDF. Requested 10 days hardship credit and asked manager attestation. Also requested 2 donated leave days from team bank.

Sofia (People Ops): Received. We'll review within 3 business days. If approved, Benefits will notify Payroll to process the payment. If donated leave is used, payroll will convert those donated days to paid leave and it will show on your payslip.

Ari (Payroll): We'll include a payslip line "Hardship childcare credit" and separate line for any donated leave conversion. If you want a pre-projection DM me and I'll run numbers.

Taylor M.: thank you all 49b. Appreciate the fast help.

Maya (Manager): Attested. Ping me if you need a block on your calendar for quiet hours.

Sofia (People Ops): Updating thread when Benefits decides. Good luck!
_notes: Thread about unexpected school closure while on unpaid extension: emergency family support form, hardship credit, donated team leave bank, payroll tax treatment, manager attestation, lactation room booking, and process timelines. Short Slack-style messages with internal links and codes.
